body:
Removed card kind, expected result and owner from the editor, source/API schemas, CLI validation and projections. Card descriptions now share project click-to-edit Markdown, outside-click rendering and autosave; both dialogs are centered and omit Change history.

Five existing cards, including one archived card, were cleaned through versioned CLI commands. Bodies and retained metadata were preserved. Both projects validate cleanly. The existing local runtime was updated and its instance, epoch, source versions, assets and original-command replay were verified.

Verification: full local gate (216 Rust, 95 JavaScript, 12 Python), all ten release browser suites and broad HTTPS smoke. Chromium emulation is not physical-device acceptance. Evidence: progress/2026-09-22-card-editor-simplification.md.

metadata.summary: Card metadata and description editor simplified
